scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Abram sits beside a tent under a tree, looking upward as a dome of golden light surrounds him against a mountainous evening landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses a sheltering glow to suggest the reassurance and protection in the vision; the verse does not describe the setting or the appearance of the vision.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older Abram looks upward with an open hand outside a tent, while a household steward tends supplies among animals and tents nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Abram addressing the unseen Lord and places Eliezer amid the household; the setting and gestures are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An older Abram sits in a tent with one hand extended and looks upward. An adult household member stands near the entrance, and an empty woven cradle rests in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures Abram expressing his concern about having no offspring and a household member being his heir; the setting and cradle are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: An elderly man sits at a tent entrance with his hand on his chest, looking upward in warm evening light; a young sapling grows nearby.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the promise of an heir through the listening man and the young sapling; the verse does not describe the setting or the sapling.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man sits outside a warmly lit tent, gazing at a vast, star-filled night sky over a rocky landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene pictures the moment of looking toward the stars; the tent and landscape are artistic details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man rests a hand on his heart and looks up at a star-filled sky beside a lamplit tent in a rocky landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The scene imaginatively depicts trust through the man’s posture and a night landscape; the verse itself does not specify these visual details.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed traveler holding a staff stands on a rocky hillside, looking over a sunlit valley of fields, a winding road, a river, and distant settlements.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene evokes the journey from Ur and the land Yahweh promises; the landscape and the traveler’s pose are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man holding a staff stands on a rocky overlook with one hand raised toward the sky, above a sunlit valley of fields, trees, water, and distant hills.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined setting and gesture portray the speaker’s question; the verse does not describe the landscape or his posture.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man gathers a heifer, a goat, and a ram in a sunlit rocky landscape, with a turtledove and a pigeon in the foreground.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts the animals being gathered in response to the instruction; the verse itself records what he was told to bring.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A robed man kneels beside animal portions arranged opposite one another on rocky ground, with two whole birds nearby in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative watercolor depicts the arrangement described in the verse; its setting and visual details are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Abram raises a staff and extends his hand toward vultures flying above animal carcasses in a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene depicts Abram driving away the vultures described in Genesis 15:11; the setting and visual details are artistic interpretations.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Abram sleeps on rocky ground beneath a setting sun as immense dark clouds spread across the sky and landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene uses the setting sun and encroaching darkness to evoke the deep sleep and great terror described in the verse; its landscape and details are artistic interpretation.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Abram sits solemnly beneath a sunset while, in the landscape beyond him, weary laborers carry stones near a settlement under an overseer's watch.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene places Abram alongside a vision of the hardship foretold for his descendants; it does not depict the entire four hundred years.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Families carrying baskets, bundles, textiles and vessels walk from a city under dark clouds toward a sunlit landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined departure gives visual form to the promise of coming out with great possessions; the shadow over the city suggests the promised judgment.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A small group carries a linen-wrapped elderly man toward a rock-cut burial place in a sunlit, hilly landscape.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imagined burial scene reflects the verse’s promise of peace and burial at a good old age; its setting and figures are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Travelers of different ages walk with a pack donkey along a rocky path toward a sunlit valley and distant town.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene suggests the future return and passing generations; the travelers and landscape are an artistic interpretation, not details specified by the verse.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A smoking firepot and a flaming torch illuminate a path between rows of divided animal pieces beneath a starry night sky.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative scene portrays the smoking firepot and burning torch passing between the pieces described in the verse; the landscape and arrangement are artistic choices.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Abram stands with a staff on a rocky overlook, gazing across sunlit hills and a winding river toward distant mountains.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: This imaginative landscape evokes the breadth of the land in the covenant; it is not a literal view of the named boundaries.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: Three family groups gather among tents, animals, crops, and a winding path in a sunlit landscape of hills and distant buildings.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The three groups are an imaginative way to evoke the peoples named in the verse; their appearance and activities are not specified by the text.

scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: In a sunlit valley, people tend sheep, draw water, and work among stone settlements and fields on neighboring hills.
